Metric_Name: Mean final delay per affected call
Operational_Definition: Mean of final delay over affected calls at the defined observation horizon.
Required_Definition_or_Caution: Specify horizon and treatment of calls arriving after the window.

Operational_Definition: Maximum final delay among vessels in the defined cohort.
Required_Definition_or_Caution: Do not confuse with accumulated delay across calls.

Operational_Definition: Maximum final delay across vessels at the observation horizon.
Required_Definition_or_Caution: Separate from accumulated delay; define final horizon.

Operational_Definition: Maximum sum of delay accrued by an individual vessel across its affected calls.
Required_Definition_or_Caution: Do not use call-level sum as a vessel-level measure.

Operational_Definition: Sum of delay over affected calls.
Required_Definition_or_Caution: Not a count of unique delayed vessels.

Operational_Definition: Maximum simultaneous active calls under the replay definition.
Required_Definition_or_Caution: Not berth occupancy or validated physical capacity.

Operational_Definition: Duration concurrency exceeds a predeclared threshold.
Required_Definition_or_Caution: Threshold and time aggregation must be specified before analysis.

Operational_Definition: Affected calls not recovered by the defined observation horizon.
Required_Definition_or_Caution: Define recovery criterion and right-censoring at end of window.

Operational_Definition: Affected vessels with at least one unrecovered affected call at the defined horizon.
Required_Definition_or_Caution: Define vessel cohort and end-window censoring.

Operational_Definition: Elapsed time from disruption onset to meeting the predeclared recovery criterion.
Required_Definition_or_Caution: Specify recovery criterion and handling of never-recovered units.

Operational_Definition: Distribution of delay across affected calls grouped by port.
Required_Definition_or_Caution: Port call count is not berth capacity or throughput capacity.

Operational_Definition: Distribution and uncertainty of outcomes across independent replications.
Required_Definition_or_Caution: Requires selected replication count, seed policy and estimand.
